full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of an adrenal gland sliced to reveal the cut surface. The image shows multiple well-circumscribed nodules expanding the gland, which is characteristic of adrenal cortical nodular hyperplasia. The lobulated, yellowish-tan nodules replace normal architecture. The overall appearance is consistent with macronodular adrenal hyperplasia.

random.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of a nerve, specifically demonstrating plexiform neurofibroma. The cross-section reveals multiple enlarged nerve fascicles surrounded by thickened epineurium, giving a characteristic 'bag of worms' appearance. The lesion is well-circumscribed and composed of multinodular tan-pink tissue. This tumor is a classic hallmark of neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1).
